en.notifyPendingBody:
{device} · {name} · {size}
Receive this item before pasting. You can also receive it from History.
en.notifyReadyBody:
{name}
Received and placed on the clipboard.
en.notifyReceivedBody:
{name}
Your clipboard was kept. Use Copy to clipboard when ready; this is also available in History.
en.transferError_dest_unavailable: The save location is unavailable. Check it in Settings.
en.transferError_file_too_large: The save location is on a FAT32 drive, which cannot hold files over 4 GB.
en.transferError_write_failed: The files could not be written.
en.transferError_hash_mismatch: A file was damaged in transit.
en.transferError_source_changed: A file was changed on the sending computer while it was being sent.
en.transferError_source_missing: A file was removed from the sending computer.
en.transferError_read_error: The sending computer could not read a file.

zh-Hans.notifyPendingBody:

ja.notifyPendingTitle: 受信するとペーストできます

{name}

{name}
受信してクリップボードに入れました。
ja.notifyReceivedBody:
{name}
現在のクリップボードは保持しました。クリップボードに入れる操作は履歴からもできます。
